segments.title: A live conversation
segments.explanation: The demo sends live input into Gemini and receives a response during the interaction. Follow the direction from input to response.

segments.title: The shared tab becomes input
segments.explanation: The learner shares a tab. The model describes visible content in that tab. Pointing links the visible document to the response.

segments.title: Focus on selected text
segments.explanation: The learner asks the model to read highlighted text. The selection narrows what the model should pay attention to.

segments.title: Different tools, different jobs
segments.explanation: The highlighted description names search, code execution and function calling. This part reads those capabilities; it does not demonstrate executing code.

segments.title: More than one kind of input
segments.explanation: Multimodal means working with different input types. The two hands present text on one side and images or audio on the other; the diagram brings them together.

segments.title: An interruption changes the turn
segments.explanation: The model begins a story, then the learner interrupts. The current reply gives way to the learner's new turn. Watch the transition, not just the moving hands.

segments.title: Earlier context helps a later answer
segments.explanation: The learner asks about previous parts of the conversation. The model refers back to earlier topics. This illustrates context within the demonstrated conversation, not unlimited permanent memory.

segments.title: Review the main ideas
segments.explanation: The demo closes. Replay a section to compare shared input, interruptions and conversation context. These three ideas are the focus of the visual illustrations.
